name: PropXchain Conveyancer
description: Agent-facing access to PropXchain UK property conveyancing transactions on the Internet Computer: read transaction state, phase and checklist status, document proofs and property intelligence, and join a transaction via its TX-XXXX-XXXX invite code. The service endpoint speaks Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC over streamable HTTP); the tools below are exposed as MCP tools rather than A2A message/send tasks.

oauth2.description: Authorization server https://auth.propxchain.com (RFC 8414 metadata at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server). Anonymous registration yields read-only scopes; consequential scopes need a human claim ceremony.

scopes.chain:read: Read on-chain transaction, property and document records
scopes.tx:read: Read transactions the agent has been invited to
scopes.panel:read: Read conveyancer and provider panel options
scopes.aml:write: Initiate AML / identity checks (requires human approval)
scopes.exchange:confirm: Confirm exchange of contracts (requires human approval)

skills.name: Join a transaction by invite code
skills.description: Adds the agent to a transaction's access list using the TX-XXXX-XXXX invite code the user shares. Idempotent.
examples: Join transaction TX-1234-ABCD as my assistant

skills.name: Read transaction state
skills.description: Returns a transaction's parties, phase, status, chain of linked transactions and outstanding items.

skills.name: Track and update the conveyancing checklist
skills.description: Reads phase checklists and marks items complete where the agent has been granted write access.
examples: Which checklist items are still open?

skills.name: Register and verify documents
skills.description: Lists documents on a transaction, registers a document's SHA-256 hash on-chain and verifies a file against its on-chain proof. Files never leave the user's device.
examples: Verify this TA6 against the chain

skills.name: Property intelligence
skills.description: Returns HM Land Registry title data, search results and address intelligence for a property on a transaction.
examples: Summarise the title register for 12 Example Road

skills.name: Message transaction parties
skills.description: Posts a message into the transaction's shared thread visible to seller, buyer, conveyancer and agent.
examples: Tell the conveyancer the searches are back

skills.name: Explain the conveyancing process
skills.description: Plain-English explanation of any stage of a UK sale or purchase and what the next step is.
examples: What happens between exchange and completion?
